community.reason: Level 2: the only specific activities are employee development (Learning Labs, leader coaching), so Community is capped at 2; 'invests in co-workers and communities' is general language and reseller/customer IT training is marketing.

entrepreneurship.reason: Level 1: the company serves SMB end-users and resellers with cloud and ordinary financing services but describes no specific program aimed at barriers to starting or growing a business.

notes: Item 7 targeted excerpt was empty. The filing refers to a fiscal year 2024 Corporate Citizenship Report for additional human capital information, but the 10-K itself gives specific activities and over 150 words of discussion, so coverage is sufficient and no second look is triggered. A Chief Learning and Belonging Officer role was created in FY2025; it is a title with no described inclusion program, so it was not scored separately. Pay equity analysis (E3) was judged borderline between levels 1 and 2 for Cross-cultural; the lower level was applied per rule 7. Reseller product training and customer IT training were treated as marketing and OEM services, not external education. Floor plan financing and other reseller credit are ordinary serving activities.
